drums.tags: Amapiano. Log drum basslines play syncopated, percussive patterns with a characteristic woody, resonant timbre. Shakers and high-frequency percussion maintain a steady sixteenth-note pulse. A deep, sub-heavy kick drum hits on every beat. Soulful, jazzy electric piano chords provide harmonic texture with soft attack and long release. A bright, staccato synth lead plays a repetitive melodic hook. The tempo is 113 BPM in the key of C minor. The arrangement features a minimalist build-up where the log drum drops out periodically to create tension before re-entering with heavy low-end emphasis.

[Intro]
[shakers and soft percussion enter]
[jazzy electric piano chords]

[Main Section]
[four-on-the-floor kick drum enters]
[syncopated log drum bassline enters]
[staccato synth lead melody]

[Breakdown]
[log drum drops out]
[electric piano chords sustain]
[shakers continue]

[Drop]
[log drum re-enters with heavy sub-bass]
[bright synth lead continues]
